title: A reader that stays open when the parse throws
prompt: LedgerReader closes its reader in a finally block that can itself throw, and the close is skipped when the constructor of the stream fails. Rewrite it with try-with-resources so the handle is released on every path, and keep the method's signature.
check: codeonly LedgerReader.java | grep -qE 'try *\(' && ! codeonly LedgerReader.java | grep -qE 'finally' && ! codeonly LedgerReader.java | grep -qE '\.close\(\)' && grep -q 'public List<String> lines' LedgerReader.java
